items.title: Surface escalation.advisories on the DONE Review-escalation pass path
items.context: In done-oracle.ts the Review-escalation doneCheckRow (~706-713): when escalation.ok===true AND escalation.advisories?.length, append the advisories to the row DETAIL (the always-printed field; renderDoneChecklist skips the hint on pass rows) so a passing DONE still shows the whole-tree-drift re-attestation advisory. Keep status=pass and blocking unchanged. Verify renderDoneChecklist actually prints the advisory on the pass row. Also check the machine.ts DONE guard (~882) ok-path and the Review-assurance-floor row do not separately swallow the same advisory; surface where an operator would otherwise miss it. Do NOT change eventsWithStoryFilesHashDowngrade or block DONE.
items.userSees: On a DONE where host verdicts were downgrade-accepted (materialHash drift + storyFilesHash match), the DONE checklist Review-escalation row PASSES but its detail now includes e.g. "host verdict ...: materialDigest drift accepted because storyFilesHash matches; re-attestation advisory required" so the operator sees the drift. With no drift, no advisory text appears.

items.title: Smoke: DONE surfaces the drift advisory on the pass path
items.context: Add a smoke (packages/main/src/tasks/*-smoke.ts, auto-discovered + npm wiring) that builds an escalation report with a downgrade-accepted host verdict (materialHash drift + matching storyFilesHash) and asserts the rendered DONE checklist Review-escalation row is PASS AND contains the re-attestation advisory text; and a control where no drift -> pass with no advisory text. Prefer driving the real done-oracle render path.
items.userSees: node packages/main/dist/tasks/<smoke>.js prints its checks and exits 0; full npm test exits 0 with the new smoke in the chain.
